name: Can I convert my tub into a walk-in shower without moving plumbing?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert my tub into a walk-in shower without moving plumbing?

acceptedAnswer.text: In many cases, it is possible to convert a tub into a walk-in shower without extensively relocating plumbing. The existing drain and water supply lines can often be adapted for the new shower setup. However, some adjustments or minor modifications to the rough-in plumbing may be necessary to ensure proper drainage and fixture placement. An on-site assessment helps determine the exact requirements for your bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Often, a tub-to-shower conversion can use existing plumbing with minor modifications. An assessment determines exact needs for drain and supply lines.
